title: Exhaustion of the combined indices
statement: Let $s,a$ be natural numbers and let $P$ be a property of the indices in a set of size $s+a+1$. Suppose $P$ holds at every index in the first block, at every index in the second block, and at the single remaining index. Then $P$ holds at every index in the combined set.
